name: Achshaph
overview: Achshaph is identified in Scripture as an ancient city located in North Palestine, mentioned specifically in the context of regional kings and territorial boundaries. In Joshua 11:1, Achshaph is noted as one of the kingdoms allied with Jabin king of Hazor, indicating its political significance during the conquest of Canaan. Later, Joshua 12:20 lists the king of Achshaph among the defeated rulers, affirming its place within the broader narrative of Israel's territorial inheritance. Additionally, Joshua 19:25 includes Achshaph as a border city within the tribal allotments, further emphasizing its geographical and historical importance in the land promised to Israel.
